title: Reglos: A Self-Evolving Personal Memory Agent with Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.06049v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personal agents draw on past conversations to tailor their responses to each user. Their memory systems store and update what each user says, and coding agents now also rewrite the harness that turns this memory into the model's context. Such patches risk overfitting, because one tested only on the failures it targets can fix those cases and help nowhere else. We present Reglos, a training-free personal memory agent that tests whether harness changes help beyond the failures they were written to fix. Its self-evolving memory adds to each user's append-only record with every conversation, as new preferences supersede old ones and facts can be forgotten. Its harness improves through recursive self-improvement, in which a coding agent proposes patches from failure traces and a critic from a second model family screens each one for benchmark gaming. After the harness is frozen, a fixed evaluator decides which further patches to accept. With

translated_title: Reglos：一个具备递归自我改进能力的自进化个人记忆智能体
translated_abstract: 个人智能体借助过去的对话记录来为每位用户量身定制回复。其记忆系统负责存储和更新每个用户所说的内容，而如今编码智能体还能重写将记忆转化为模型上下文的“线束”（harness）。然而，这类补丁存在过拟合的风险，因为仅在针对的失败案例上进行测试的补丁，可能只修复了这些案例而对其他情况毫无帮助。我们提出了Reglos，一个无需训练的个人记忆智能体，它能够检验线束的修改是否在所针对的失败案例之外也带来帮助。其自进化记忆会在每次对话中向每个用户的仅追加式记录中添加内容，新偏好会取代旧偏好，事实也可能被遗忘。其线束通过递归自我改进不断优化：由一个编码智能体根据失败轨迹提出补丁，并由来自另一个模型系列的批评者筛选每个补丁，以防范“基准测试作弊”行为。在线束被冻结后，由固定的评估器决定接受哪些后续补丁。该论文摘要在此处被截断。
tldr: Reglos是一个无需训练的个人记忆智能体，通过自进化记忆机制和递归自我改进来优化记忆线束，并利用异构模型系列的批评者筛选补丁以防止基准测试作弊，从而验证线束修改在目标失败案例之外同样有效，避免过拟合。
en_tdlr: Reglos is a training-free personal memory agent that combines self-evolving memory with recursive self-improvement—using a cross-model-family critic to screen patches against benchmark gaming—so that harness changes are verified to help beyond the specific failures they target, avoiding overfitting.
